summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a.tgz from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz), extracts it, chmods the extracted file to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode. The HTTPS request sets rejectUnauthorized: false, disabling TLS certificate validation. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded bytes, and the URL is not versioned to a signed release. The delivery destination is not a publisher-owned domain but a bare IP address, and any party controlling that IP or able to MitM the unauthenticated TLS connection can substitute arbitrary code that runs on the installer's machine as a consequence of npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
